tools.name: search_modules
tools.description: Search Open Mercato modules: official, community and third-party packages, plus the modules built into Open Mercato core.

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: One module: anatomy, compatibility per line, trust, install command and the author README marked untrusted.

tools.name: check_compat
tools.description: Is a module verified on this app's Open Mercato version: receipts, static fit and agent policy.

tools.name: plan_install
tools.description: Install plan for one or more modules: requires closure, commands with exact versions, permissions, settings, conflicts and the consent text.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Catalog changes since a date: new entries, new versions, receipt transitions and level changes.
